title: Graduated Late Charge by Days Beyond Grace — Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Unpaid Installments
content:
**Schedule of Servicing Fees — graduated charge, Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contract (installment left unpaid past its grace period).**

**Rule.** The days beyond grace are the calendar days from the contract's next due date to today less the product's grace period of 10 days. When the days beyond grace are from 1 through 7, the charge figured at the rate is halved and the result rounded down to the whole dollar; when they are from 8 through 14, the charge figured at the rate is multiplied by three quarters and the result rounded down to the whole dollar; in every other case the charge figured at the rate is kept to the cent.

The grace period read here is 10 calendar days on Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Tier 5, Tier 4, Tier 3, Tier 2, Tier 1 and Tier 1+ alike. The charge figured at the rate is the late charge computed on the unpaid installment portion at the rate that applies, rounded to the cent, before the late-charge cap; the cap then applies to the figure this rule produces.

**Counting.** A count of calendar days from one date to another is the second date less the first, so the first date is not counted and the second is; the count is zero or negative when the second date is not after the first.

| Days from the next due date to today | Days beyond grace | Figure carried to the cap |
|---|---|---|
| 11 to 17 | 1 to 7 | half, rounded down to the whole dollar |
| 18 to 24 | 8 to 14 | three quarters, rounded down to the whole dollar |
| 25 or more | 15 or more | the charge at the rate, to the cent |
| 10 or fewer | 0 or fewer | the charge at the rate, to the cent |

## Worked cases (hypothetical inputs)

A charge figured at the rate of 19.62 dollars:

- 14 days after the due date (4 beyond grace): half is 9.81, rounded down to 9.00 dollars.
- 21 days after the due date (11 beyond grace): three quarters is 14.715, rounded down to 14.00 dollars.
- 26 days after the due date (16 beyond grace): 19.62 dollars.
